chunks: 479 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Ziyād al-Ṣayqal said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked how women should perform salat over funerals if there is no man with them, so he said:
"They should all stand together in a single row, and no woman should step ahead of them."
It was said: Then in an obligatory salat, may some of them lead others? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.الْجَنَائِزِ: funerals; the deceased over whom the funeral prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: How should women perform the funeral prayer when no man is present, and can a woman lead other women in obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on how women perform salat al-janazah when no man is present: they stand together in one row without one woman stepping forward ahead of the others. It also states that in an obligatory salat, a woman may lead other women.
